scripts.prisma:deploy:central: bash scripts/ensure-central-database-url.sh && bunx prisma db push --schema=src/infrastructure/prisma/central/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss --skip-generate
scripts.prisma:generate: bun run prisma:generate:central && bun run prisma:generate:tenant
scripts.prisma:deploy:tenant: bash scripts/ensure-tenant-database-url.sh && bunx prisma db push --schema=src/infrastructure/prisma/tenant/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss --skip-generate
scripts.prisma:migrate:tenant: bash scripts/ensure-tenant-database-url.sh && bunx prisma migrate deploy --schema=src/infrastructure/prisma/tenant/schema.prisma
scripts.db:reset:central-tenants: echo 'Run this script from the project root: bash scripts/reset-central-and-tenants.sh'
